audio.no-pack: None. No pack assigned to this profile. Assign one in Data Manager.
audio.pack-detail: {layers, select, extended {layered · extended slots · } layered {layered · } other {}}{freq} Hz · {channels, select, mono {Mono} other {Stereo}}
audio.device.freq.auto: MSU packs are 44100 Hz, OPUZ packs 48000 Hz. Set automatically from the assigned pack. Switch Configuration to Manual to change it.
audio.device.freq.manual: Must match the pack format: 44100 Hz for MSU/Deluxe, 48000 Hz for OPUZ/Deluxe OPUZ.
audio.device.channels.auto: Replacement music is always stereo. Set automatically from the assigned pack. Switch Configuration to Manual to change it.
audio.device.channels.manual: Mono collapses the output to one channel; Stereo keeps left and right separate.
audio.device.samples.auto: Set automatically from the assigned pack. Switch Configuration to Manual to change it.
audio.device.samples.manual: Smaller buffers reduce latency but may crackle; larger ones are steadier but add delay.
contributing.sanctuary.signed-out-lead: Sign in so bug reports carry your name and appear on the hub.
disabled.japanese-font: Needs the Japanese sprites imported in Data > Sprites
display.aspect.label: Aspect Ratio
display.aspect.locked: Turn on Extended Rendering to pick a ratio other than 4:3.
display.aspect.description.original: Use the original 256-pixel width. Extend Y chooses 224 or 240 lines.
display.aspect.description.screen: Matches the full physical screen ratio.
display.aspect.description.wide: Choose a fixed ratio, including true 4:3. Uses 240 lines.
display.aspect.description.custom: Set an exact width : height ratio.
display.vsync.advisory: {description} Your display is running at {hz} Hz, which is not a whole multiple of 60. Some frames will be shown longer than others whatever this setting does. Setting your display to {target} Hz makes the timing even.
hud.ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
hud.ratio.description: Match follows the game view. Fixed ratios pin the HUD to a narrower area.
hud.style.label: Style
hud.style.description: Original is the game's own HUD. Modern adds the app-drawn HUD and pause menu, and the modern control scheme.
hud.style.no-sprites: No HUD sprites are extracted for this ROM. Extract them to use the HUD.
hud.style.too-narrow: Modern needs a display of 16:9 or wider. Widen the aspect ratio in Display settings.
sprite.title: Player Sprite
sprite.hint: Manage sprites in Data > Character Studio. Applies right away.
